status: secondary follow-up; dataset already inspected in prior primary audit
freeze_scope: analysis choices below frozen before calculating the fixed-cohort surface
reference_population: the 519 instances actionable by base {astar-ec, astar-ed3} at T_ref=7200 s under repetition 1
refuse_rule: REFUSE is admissible iff no solver in the current portfolio is admissible; REFUSE is not admissible when any solver is admissible

metrics.coverage: fraction of all 519 reference instances with >=1 admissible solver
metrics.H_total_bits: exact minimum Shannon entropy over all 519 instances with augmented admissible sets: solver set if nonempty, else {REFUSE}
metrics.pair_conflicts_total: unordered pairs of reference instances whose augmented admissible sets are disjoint
metrics.H_actionable_bits: exact minimum Shannon entropy conditional on the actionable subset, reported descriptively
metrics.pair_conflicts_actionable: unordered disjoint-admissibility pairs within the actionable subset, reported descriptively

portfolio_enumeration: all 2^6 candidate subsets for each T
capability_budget_frontier: for each T and K=0..6, among subsets with <=K additions: maximize coverage; then minimize H_total_bits; then minimize pair_conflicts_total; then fewer added capabilities; then lexicographic tie-break
guardrail: This is not an independent blind replication. It is a frozen secondary structural follow-up on already-inspected BNSL-2016 data. No budget or portfolio will be dropped after seeing outcomes.
